description: This file defines the VTEventsManager class responsible for creating, managing, and triggering events in the vtiger CRM system. It provides methods to register, unregister, activate, deactivate handlers, initialize and clear trigger cache, list handlers, and trigger events.

classes.name: VTEventsManager
classes.description: Class for managing event handlers and triggers within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the VTEventsManager with a database connection object.

methods.name: registerHandler
methods.description: Registers a new event handler with specified parameters if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: initTriggerCache
methods.description: Initializes the cache for specified event types, optionally forcing reinitialization.

methods.name: clearTriggerCache
methods.description: Clears the cache for a specific event or all events if no specific event is provided.

methods.name: unregisterHandler
methods.description: Removes an event handler from the system.

methods.name: getTrigger
methods.description: Returns a trigger object for a given event.

methods.name: triggerEvent
methods.description: Triggers an event with provided data.

methods.name: setModuleForHandler
methods.description: Associates a handler class with a specific module.

methods.name: listHandlersForModule
methods.description: Lists all handler classes associated with a module.

methods.name: listActiveEventHandlers
methods.description: Returns a list of all active event handlers.

methods.name: listAllEventHandlers
methods.description: Returns a list of all event handlers regardless of their active state.

methods.name: listEventHandlers
methods.description: Internal method to format a list of event handlers from database results.
